description: The bar chart, titled “QA-2,” compares the performance of two Korean large language models—EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 and RedWhale (our)—on a question-answering evaluation, broken down into three accuracy categories: Correct (dark purple), Partially Correct (medium blue), and Incorrect (light blue), as indicated by the legend at the bottom. The horizontal axis represents the percentage of responses falling into each category, while the vertical axis lists the two models. For EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, the stacked bar shows 92.9% Correct, a small segment of Partially Correct (value not labeled but visually minimal), and 4.3% Incorrect. For RedWhale (our), the stacked bar shows a higher Correct rate of 95.7%, a Partially Correct segment of 1.4%, and an Incorrect rate of 2.9%. The chart visually emphasizes RedWhale’s superior performance, with a larger Correct segment and smaller Incorrect segment compared to EEVE, suggesting improved accuracy in the QA-2 task after efficient continual pretraining.
